intervals.label: data taking (runs R97 to R01)
intervals.note: Annual 3-4 month runs 1997-2001 at the AGS (24 GeV/c protons from the AGS produce the muon beam).
intervals.quote: obtained in typically 3-4 month annual runs through 2001. In this paper, we indicate the running periods by the labels R97 - R01.

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: End of data taking is taken as the last run label (R01); the storage ring was moved to Fermilab in 2013 for the successor experiment.
intervals.quote: Many people have made important contributions towards the success of E821 over the past twenty years when this experiment was proposed, built and completed.

placements.locator: Fermilab press release (2025), paragraph on the ring
placements.note: Campus-grade BNL site; the AGS experimental hall is not located in a fetched source. Start is the first run (R97); end is the departure of the ring (2013).
placements.quote: In 2013, Brookhaven's magnetic storage ring was transported from Long Island, New York, to Fermilab in Batavia, Illinois.

summary.plain: The superconducting magnetic ring in which muons circled and decayed, with detectors around its edge that recorded the positrons from the decays.
summary.technical: Muon storage ring fed by a 24 GeV/c AGS proton beam through a pion/muon channel and inflector; positron calorimeters measure the spin-precession frequency. The same magnet was relocated to Fermilab in 2013.
